The first transport is away!|[[Romas Navander]] during the [[Battle of Hoth]]||audio=Navander-Transport.flac}} The '''''Quantum Storm''''' was a [[GR-75 medium transport]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. ==History== {{Quote|That was the ion cannon. Command center says the first transport is away.''"
"''Few more of those and maybe we'll head home ourselves, huh?|Rebel troopers [[Roja]] and [[Hazram Namir]] at [[Perimeter Outpost Delta]]|''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]''}} [[File:QuantumStorm.png|thumb|left|180px|The ''Quantum Storm'' escaping the ''Tyrant'']] The ''Quantum Storm'' was the first [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[GR-75 medium transport|transport]] to escape the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[blockade]] at the [[Battle of Hoth]]. It successfully bypassed the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tyrant]]'', thanks to the well-timed shots of [[Echo Base]]'s [[V-150 Planet Defender|v-150]] [[ion cannon]] issued by [[Toryn Farr]].{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Toryn Farr - Communications Officer}} As the first [[transport]] to evacuate the [[planet]], the ''Quantum Storm'' carried non-combatant personnel of [[Echo Base]].''[[Lost Stars]]'' Imperial defector and [[Governor]] [[Everi Chalis]] was scheduled to depart on the transport, but stayed behind to help an injured [[Captain]] [[Micha Evon]]. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Quantum Storm}} *''[[Lost Stars]]'' {{Ab|Lost Stars (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} *''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'' {{Ab|Battlefront: Twilight Company (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} *{{Film|V}} {{1st}} *''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]'' {{Ab|The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?
